name: yaos
description: A zero-terminal, real-time sync engine powered by your own sync server.

scripts.test:regressions: bun tests/diff-regressions.mjs && bun tests/disk-mirror-regressions.mjs && bun tests/markdown-ingest-regressions.mjs && bun tests/closed-file-mirror.ts && bun tests/folder-rename.ts && bun tests/chunked-doc-store.ts && bun tests/trace-store.ts && bun tests/server-hardening.ts
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:regressions && bun run test:integration:server:selfhosted && bun run test:server-update-local
scripts.version: bun version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
